claim: For the Lai–Kuate–Pei–Fotsin sine-modified Sprott-B flow \(\dot x_1=a(x_2-x_1)\), \(\dot x_2=kx_1\sin x_3+x_4\), \(\dot x_3=b-x_1x_2\), and \(\dot x_4=-cx_2\), assume \(a>0\), \(c>0\), \(k>0\), and \(b\in\mathbb R\). The scalar \(H=x_3+x_1^2/(2a)\) satisfies the exact balance \(\dot H=b-x_1^2\). Consequently every bounded forward trajectory obeys \(\lim_{T\to\infty}T^{-1}\int_0^T x_1(t)^2\,dt=b\), so no bounded forward trajectory exists when \(b<0\). When \(b=0\), every recurrent point lies on the equilibrium line \(\{(0,0,\xi,0):\xi\in\mathbb R\}\). When \(b>0\), every compactly supported invariant probability measure \(\mu\) satisfies \(\int x_1\,d\mu=\int x_2\,d\mu=0\), \(\int x_1^2\,d\mu=\int x_1x_2\,d\mu=b\), and hence \(\operatorname{Var}_\mu(x_1)=b\). Its support must meet both \(x_1>0\) and \(x_1<0\); in particular every periodic orbit crosses \(x_1=0\) and attains \(|x_1|\ge\sqrt b\). These constraints are independent of the sinusoidal gain \(k\) and give an exact recurrence law for the same system whose 2020 introducing paper studied boundedness and infinitely many hidden attractors numerically.

correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation gives \(\dot H=b-x_1^2\) exactly. Boundedness makes \((H(T)-H(0))/T	o0\), proving the time-average law and excluding \(b<0\). At \(b=0\), recurrence plus monotonicity forces \(x_1\equiv0\), then the remaining equations force the equilibrium line. For compactly supported invariant measures, zero mean Lie derivatives of \(x_4\), \(x_1\), \(H\), and \(x_3\) give the four moment identities. The bundled symbolic script independently checks every algebraic identity used.

value.rationale: The introducing paper motivates boundedness and coexistence numerically while stating that analytic boundedness is difficult. The exact balance turns the forcing parameter into a rigorous global recurrence selector: negative forcing forbids bounded forward dynamics, zero forcing collapses recurrence to equilibria, and positive forcing fixes the stationary RMS amplitude independently of the periodic gain. This is a structural, falsifiable constraint on every compact recurrent state of the published system rather than a recomputation of a displayed trajectory.
